_type.description: What this document is. Written by aet-eaw-edit; leave it alone. A file declaring anything else is not opened as a mod project.

_typeVersion.description: The format of this project FILE, not the version of the mod (that lives in modinfo.version). Written by aet-eaw-edit as namespace-version, e.g. aetswg-1.0.0. aet-eaw-edit refuses to open a project whose format is newer than it understands, rather than reading it as best it can and writing its own shape back over it.

name.description: Project display name and identity. When omitted, the server falls back to the .pgproj file name (without extension).

modinfo.description: Optional embedded modinfo metadata. Parsed against the full modinfo spec; the properties listed here are authoring hints only and are not exhaustive.

ai.description: Reserved - currently excluded from XML parsing.

storyDialog.description: Directories holding story-dialog .txt scripts (chaptered text/media playlists referenced from story events via Story_Dialog). Only files under these directories get the story-dialog language service.

localisation.description: The project's single localisation source: which directory (relative to this .pgproj) holds the translation files, and what format they're stored in.

type.description: Storage format of the translation files: CSV, DAT, XML or NLS. Matched case-insensitively, as the loader does - a pattern rather than an enum so that 'dat' and 'Dat' are accepted here exactly as they are when the project loads.

credits.description: Which files in this directory are ordered credits files (duplicate keys allowed, row order significant) rather than keyed text files. Omit to use the engine naming convention.

detection.description: convention: files whose name begins with 'credits' (the default). explicit: only the files listed below. none: nothing is a credits file.

files.description: Filenames to treat as credits files, with or without extension. Required when detection is 'explicit'; additive when 'convention'; ignored when 'none'.

icons.description: Where this project's UI icons live. Omit entirely to use the engine convention (data/art/textures/mt_commandbar).

megaTexture.description: Path to the mega texture pair relative to this .pgproj, WITHOUT an extension - it names both the .mtd directory and the .tga atlas, e.g. "data/art/textures/mt_commandbar".

sourceRoots.description: Folders of raw icon source images that a packer builds the mega texture from, in priority order. The packed .mtd always wins; these let the server tell a missing icon apart from one that exists but was never repacked.
